title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-08-01
lineage: AudMR > C > C > C > CD;AudMR > R > DAT > WAV > SHN
taper: Unknown & Jeffrey Siniawsky, Neil Merin, and Joel Smith

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a classic ’73 stadium show highlighted by an epic Dark Star > El Paso > Eyes > Morning Dew sequence.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised as top‑notch, especially the ten‑minute spacey jam that moves from Dark Star into El Paso and then rolls through long, classic Eyes and Morning Dew.  Listeners note the surprisingly clear stadium audience tape for a 1973 gig, with Keith’s keyboards and Jerry’s guitar on fire, making this one of the standout early‑’70s shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both musical performance and surprisingly good audience sound across multiple detailed reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers call the stadium audience tape “surprisingly good,” “super” and “above average AUD”; clarity is noted despite the 1973 venue, with no major complaints of mud or drop‑outs.

standout_songs: Dark Star > El Paso > Eyes > Morning Dew
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for smooth transitions and a spacey, relaxed vibe, especially the jam after the verse that eases listeners into the night.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Hot, on‑fire guitar work highlighted throughout the Dark Star/El Paso jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s keyboards are described as “on fire” and a key part of the show’s brilliance.
